title: A Sign of Affection
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuki Itose is a university student who was born deaf and communicates through sign language, texting and lip reading. When the well-traveled, multilingual Itsuomi helps her with a lost tourist, she is drawn to him, and he begins learning sign language to enter her world. Their slow romance is complicated by her protective childhood friend Oushi and Itsuomi's own past.
life_message: It holds up patient, honest communication and making the effort to enter another person's world.
